# Retrieve the cached attraction results for Las Vegas with Scenic type
attractions_search = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions_las_vegas_scenic")

# Search for hotels in Las Vegas with specified criteria
hotel_results = search_hotels(
    city="Las Vegas",
    checkin_date=["2025-08-03"],
    checkout_date=["2025-08-11"],
    num_people=5,
    stars=[3],
    budget=80
)

# Save the hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels_las_vegas_3star_80pernight", value=hotel_results)

# Filter hotels based on user's budget and star rating using cached results
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotel_results,
    budget=80,
    stars=[3]
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels_las_vegas_filtered", value=filtered_hotels)

# Find the nearest scenic attractions to the filtered hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    attractions=attractions_search,
    groupBy="attraction"
)

# Save the nearest attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions_las_vegas", value=nearest_attractions)

# Sort the nearest attractions by rating
sorted_attractions = sort_results(
    results=nearest_attractions,
    column="rating_restaurants",  # Note: This column is for restaurants; adjust if needed for attractions
    ascending=True
)

# Save the sorted attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="sorted_attractions_las_vegas", value=sorted_attractions)

# Output the query summary
print("Here are some 3-star hotels in Las Vegas within your budget of $80 per night, along with nearby Scenic attractions:")
print(sorted_attractions.query_summary)
